test_policy.toefl: 非强制常规项，但有条件强制：若母语非英语，且中学课程未以英语授课满2年，则必须提交英语能力考试成绩（TOEFL / IELTS / Duolingo / Cambridge English 任一）。官网未公布最低分数。
test_policy.sat_act: 必须提交（必需项，非可选）。美国境内高中生：必须提交 SAT 或 ACT。境外高中生可用以下5种方式之一满足：①SAT或ACT ②3门不同AP考试 ③IBDP 预测/最终成绩 ④英国A-Level 预测/最终成绩（+第5种，国际学生项）。SAT/ACT自动拼分（superscore）。可自报分数，入学前需官方送分。

prompts: 第1题（全体必答，≤100词）：As you seek admission to Dartmouth's Class of 2031, what aspects of the college's academic program, community, and/or campus environment attract your interest? How is Dartmouth a good fit for you?

第2题（全体必答，二选一，≤250词）：A. There is a Quaker saying: Let your life speak. Describe the environment in which you were raised and the impact it has had on the person you are today. / B. "Be yourself," Oscar Wilde advised. "Everyone else is taken." Introduce yourself.

第3题（全体必答，六选一，≤250词）：A. What excites you? / B. Dolores Huerta 关于 purpose/impact（你如何已/将让世界更好） / C. Matt Haig 关于阅读如何让人想象他人生活 / D. Jane Goodall 关于困难对话与寻找共同点 / E. Celebrate your nerdy side. / F. Kermit the Frog "It's not easy being green" — 差异如何成为你身份/视野/使命感的一部分
supplements.word_limit: 共3篇：1篇100词以内 + 2篇250词以内（另有 Common App 主文书）

test_policy.toefl: 强烈建议（非硬性）：母语非英语/家庭主要用语非英语/中学授课主要语言非英语的国际申请者，强烈建议提交英语能力成绩。接受 TOEFL、IELTS、Duolingo、Pearson PTE、Cambridge English，及 TOEFL iBT Home Edition。多数情况下期望最低分：TOEFL iBT 105（2026年1月前考试）/ 5.5（2026年1月及之后新分制）；IELTS 8.0；Duolingo 130；PTE 75；Cambridge C1/C2 191。不接受 MyBest scores；官网明确此项为建议提交而非强制提交要求。
test_policy.sat_act: 必须提交：自 2024-25 申请季起恢复要求 SAT 或 ACT 成绩（第一年及转学申请者）。SAT/ACT 均拼分；SAT Essay / ACT Writing 可选。SAT 送分代码 3094，ACT 3800。无最低分数要求（contextual review）。

prompts: 第1题（150-250词）："There is something distinctive about Brown students. It is a blend of intellectual curiosity, creativity, and humility. A commitment to collaboration. An openness to new ideas and perspectives. A desire to make the world better. And it is resilience: the ability to recover and thrive after experiencing difficulties." From President Christina Paxson's 2025 Convocation Address. How will you use these characteristics or others to shape your approach to the Open Curriculum?

第2题（150-250词）：Students entering Brown often find that making their home on College Hill naturally invites reflection on where they came from. Share how an aspect of your growing up has inspired or challenged you, and what unique contributions this might allow you to make to the Brown community.
第3题（100-150词）：If you could teach a class on any one thing, whether academic or otherwise, what would it be?

第4题（100-150词）：Brown students care deeply about their work and the world around them. Students find contentment, satisfaction, and meaning in daily interactions and major discoveries. Whether big or small, mundane or spectacular, tell us about something that brings you joy.
附加（仅特定项目）：PLME 3篇×250词（Why medicine? / Why PLME? / 你身上能让你成为好医生的特质）；Brown|RISD 双学位 1篇 650词
supplements.word_limit: 4篇通用文书：2篇150-250词 + 2篇100-150词（本轮已取消旧版三词/一句话 Why Brown 短答）
